title: About KPGU | Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University
content: s (Amendment) Act, 2021 (Gujarat Act 15 of 2021). KPGU aims to become a  University of Global Eminence,  aligned with its vision to serve higher education, healthcare, and humanity with relentless pursuit of progress. By adhering to the KPGU Vision-2040, KPGU has positioned itself as a  Gateway to Global Excellence,  to explore opportunities that will elevate performance to new levels. KPGU has increased infrastructure to about 18 lakhs Sq.ft.
